pocket_definition: box is a POCKET box iff its whole cx and cy ranges lie within delta of the SAME completable-slot centre and its whole tilt range lies within tol of 0 mod 90 (t = tan(theta/2))

canary_trump_slot_coincidence.note: NOTE: Trump's own upright square at (s-1/2, s-1/2) coincides EXACTLY with k5_11's completable slot TR(0,0).  This is not a counterexample to the exemption: Trump is not a packing of class k5_11 (it lacks the k5_11 pin (1/2, s-1/2); its 5th upright sits at (1/2, 2.5326)), so SLOT-CROWD / the k6_23 kill is never applied to it.  But the chore's parenthetical 'a Trump square does not sit within the tolerance of a completable slot of k5_11' is not literally true at zero tolerance -- the guard that matters is the one below (no k5_11 witness box is ever classified as a pocket).
